pages.text: $(bold)Getting started$()$(br)"Sweaty Feet" — obtain a sweat bottle (the start of the chain).$(br)"A Bit Salty..." — drink a sweat bottle.$(br)"Full of Flavor!" — drink a bucket of foot-washing water.$(br)"Marinated" — hold a level-2/3 sweaty boot and get nauseated by the stench.

$(bold)Going further$()$(br)"Healthy Living" — successfully wash your sweaty feet once.$(br)"Breeding Ground" — get infected with foot fungus.$(br)"Reformed" — soak in medicinal water and cure the fungus.$(br)"Plague Inc." — spread the fungus to another player.

$(bold)Pranks$()$(br)"Biological Weapon" — drop level-2+ sweaty boots and stink out another player.$(br)"Blissfully Drunk!" — drink a sweat drink.$(br2)All of them are browsable under the "Sweaty Feet" tree in the advancements screen, and toast on unlock.
